subtitle: std::variant<Ts...> — C++17's type-safe discriminated union. restd back-ports to C++11 (runtime correctness) across 12 granular headers. SHIPPED: variant<Ts...> with all 6 ctor flavours (default, copy, move, forwarding-from-U with two-pass exact-match preference, in_place_type, in_place_index), complete assignment + emplace + member swap, observers (index, valueless_by_exception), monostate unit type, bad_variant_access exception with three-fallback inheritance chain, variant_npos sentinel, variant_size + variant_alternative traits with cv-qualified passthrough, holds_alternative<T> with exactly-once enforcement, get<I>/get<T> (8 ref-qualified overloads each), get_if<I>/get_if<T> (4 overloads each, pointer-returning non-throwing), single-variant visit with recursive index-dispatch (works for void and non-void return types), the six legacy relational operators with valueless-state semantics per [variant.relops], non-member swap, deduction guides... DEFERRED: operator<=> (separate C++20 phase), visit<R> explicit return type, multi-variant visit (recursive expansion), hash<variant> (blocked on <functional>), reference alternatives, allocator-aware ctors, conditional triviality, full constexpr surface. FORWARDING CTOR DIVERGENCE: restd uses two-pass exact-match-preferred / first-constructible-fallback selection. Matches std for the common cases (variant<int,double,string> v=3.14 -> double; variant<int,string> v="literal" -> string); diverges only when multiple alternatives are convertible from the same source with no exact match.
legend_blurb: Per-symbol coverage of the C++17 <variant> header. Shipped on C++11+ (no C++98 path — needs variadic templates + union-with-non-trivial-members). 6-year back-port to C++11. Constexpr surface and operator<=> deferred.

symbols.name: variant<Ts...>
symbols.notes: Recursive-union storage (libc++/MSVC STL pattern): variant_storage<Head,Tail...> = union { Head; variant_storage<Tail...>; } with user-provided ctor/dtor and explicit lifetime management by the surrounding variant. Six ctor flavours: default (value-inits T_0; gated on is_constructible<T_0>), copy, move, forwarding-from-U via two-pass best_match (exact-match-after-decay preferred, falls back to first-constructible-from-U), in_place_type<T>, in_place_index<I> (both with variadic args). Full assignment + emplace<T>/emplace<I> + member swap. Observers: index(), valueless_by_exception(). Internal _ref<I>() accessor surfaces the storage to free-function get/visit. RESTD AHEAD OF STD: 6-year back-port to C++11. Conditional triviality NOT implemented (always emits user-defined SMFs — correctness over optimisation). Constexpr surface NOT shipped at this phase (placement-new based lifetime management isn't constexpr-friendly pre-C++20).
symbols.failure_reason: Cannot reach C++98 — implementation requires variadic templates, rvalue references, defaulted/deleted special members, union-with-non-trivial-members. All C++11 language features.

symbols.name: monostate
symbols.notes: Empty struct. Trivially default-constructible, copyable, destructible. Six comparison operators (==, !=, <, >, <=, >=) all D_CONSTEXPR inline. Standard use case: variant<monostate, expensive_t> is default-constructible without requiring expensive_t to be. RESTD AHEAD OF STD: 6-year back-port; constexpr from C++11.
symbols.failure_reason: Same as the rest of the module — gated on C++11+ for module consistency.

symbols.name: bad_variant_access
symbols.notes: Three-fallback inheritance chain (same pattern as bad_any_cast, bad_expected_access): std::bad_cast when <typeinfo> available, std::exception when only <exception> available, standalone class otherwise. Virtual what() returns 'bad variant access'. Thrown by get<I>/get<T> on alternative mismatch and by visit on valueless variants.

symbols.name: variant_npos
symbols.notes: static_cast<size_t>(-1). Returned by variant::index() when in valueless-by-exception state. D_CONSTEXPR inline. RESTD AHEAD OF STD: 6-year back-port; constexpr from C++11.

symbols.name: variant_size
symbols.notes: variant_size<variant<Ts...>>::value == sizeof...(Ts). Cv-qualified passthrough specialisations (LWG-style). variant_size_v variable template provided when C++14 variable-templates available. Forward-declares variant<> to avoid pulling the heavy variant.hpp into trait-only consumers. RESTD AHEAD OF STD on constexpr.

symbols.name: variant_alternative
symbols.notes: variant_alternative<I, variant<Ts...>>::type == T_I (recursive type_at<I,Ts...> walk). Cv-qualified passthrough. variant_alternative_t alias template provided when C++11 alias-templates available. Out-of-range I produces static_assert error at instantiation. RESTD AHEAD OF STD: 6-year back-port.

symbols.name: holds_alternative<T>(v)
symbols.notes: Returns v.index() == index_of<T, Types...>::value. static_assert enforces 'T appears exactly once in Types' via count_of trait — same disambiguation rule std uses.

symbols.name: get<I>(v) / get<T>(v)
symbols.notes: Eight overloads total: get<I>(v&), get<I>(v const&), get<I>(v&&), get<I>(v const&&), plus the same four for get<T>(v) which dispatches to get<index_of<T,Types...>::value>(v). Throws bad_variant_access on alternative mismatch (when exceptions available; UB on -fno-exceptions builds — documented). RESTD AHEAD OF STD: 6-year back-port to C++11.

symbols.name: get_if<I>(v) / get_if<T>(v)
symbols.notes: Pointer-returning non-throwing access. Two overloads each (mutable / const); no rvalue overload — would leave the caller with a dangling pointer (matches std). Returns nullptr on null variant pointer OR alternative mismatch. get_if<T> dispatches to get_if<index_of<T,Types...>>.

symbols.name: visit
symbols.notes: Single-variant visit only. Recursive index-dispatch (visit_at_impl<I,N>) — tests v.index() == I at each level, on match returns vis(get<I>(v)); else tail-calls visit_at_impl<I+1,N>. Compiler usually folds the chain into a jump table at -O2+. Works for both non-void and void return types via static_cast<Ret>(call). Throws bad_variant_access on valueless variant input. Return type deduced from visitor's invocation on the first alternative — all alternatives must agree on return type (matches std). DEFERRED: visit<R> explicit return; multi-variant visit(vis, v1, v2, ...).
symbols.failure_reason: Single-variant visit shipped. Multi-variant visit deferred.

symbols.name: operator== / != / < / <= / > / >=
symbols.notes: Six legacy operators with proper [variant.relops] semantics: cross-index comparison routes through index() ordering (valueless < anything else); same-index dispatches to the held alternative's own operator via recursive compare_at_impl. operator!= gated out on C++20+ (synthesised by the compiler from op==). RESTD AHEAD OF STD: 6-year back-port. operator<=> deferred to a follow-up phase.

symbols.name: swap (variant)
symbols.notes: ADL non-member delegating to member swap. Member swap handles same-index (ADL swap on the alternative) and cross-index (move through a temporary variant) cases.

symbols.name: operator<=> (variant)
symbols.notes: Deferred to a follow-up phase. The recursive index-dispatch pattern used by the legacy operators generalises, but the result-type plumbing (common_comparison_category_t over all alternatives) interacts with the deferred <compare> Phase C6 work. Tracked here so the Coverage Failures sheet surfaces it.
symbols.failure_reason: Deferred — needs common_comparison_category_t over all alternatives' <=> result types (interacts with deferred <compare> Phase C6 floating-point total-order work). C++20 spaceship operator itself is a language feature; can ship from C++20.

symbols.name: visit<R>(vis, v...)  /  multi-variant visit
symbols.notes: Deferred. Multi-variant visit requires a recursive cartesian-product walk over all input variants' index spaces — implementable but heavy. visit<R> (C++20) requires the user-supplied return type as an explicit template parameter, mostly mechanical to add. Both tracked separately so the Coverage Failures sheet surfaces them.
symbols.failure_reason: Single-variant visit ships. Multi-variant visit deferred — N-ary cartesian-product index dispatch is implementable but pushes compile times; planned for a follow-up phase along with visit<R>.

symbols.name: hash<variant<Ts...>>
symbols.failure_reason: Blocked on restd::<functional> shipping the hash primary template. Will be a small follow-up file (visit-based composition over the active alternative).
